notes.title: Worn Out Demo is updated for Next Fest!
notes.content:
In preparation of June Next Fest, the demo is updated with a completely new section and more! You can expect to see even more playtime now.

[h1][b]What's different?[/b][/h1]

[h2]New Gameplay Section[/h2]

Play through a chilling new chapter, giving you a further taste into the story of Worn Out. [spoiler] You can experience it right after the previous ending, regardless of your choices. [/spoiler]

[h2]Revamped Visuals[/h2]

Multiple scenes and visuals have been updated to enhance the experience.

[h2]New Scenes and Soundtrack[/h2]

Several additional scenes have been added for you to discover, including some changes to previous choices.

Have fun & don't forget to wishlist!

notes.title: Worn Out Demo available February 28!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444732/1e05ddf27a76bf1c6bc04c5206222ee4abc2f7f4.png[/img]

This friday, you can play through the very beginning of [b]Worn Out[/b] and start out the story in the demo! You can expect to see up to [b]30 minutes[/b] of gameplay, depending on the amount of dialogue you wish to discover. 

In the meantime, wishlist Worn Out and wait for further announcements! 

If you have any feedback or questions, feel free to send an email at [url=press@morimichi.games]press@morimichi.games[/url] to get in contact.
